findings.condition: Combined used plus proposed capacity is within the capacity operating budget.

findings.implication: Modeled capacity headroom exists for the proposed workload at the declared synthetic values.
findings.nextInvestigation: Confirm real usable capacity and current consumption before relying on this result.

findings.condition: Combined backend operation demand is within the backend operating budget.

evidence.label: background backend demand
evidence.basis: declared on the demand sample; added exactly once

evidence.label: proposed backend reads
evidence.basis: derived: proposed reads × (1 − hit) + writes × factor

findings.calculation: existing 126750 ops/s + background 0 + proposed 30900 ops/s (reads 24900 + writes 6000; RAID 5 factor 2+2 per logical write) = 157650 ops/s vs 200000 ops/s budget; headroom 42350 ops/s.
findings.implication: Modeled backend load is within budget under the RAID 5 read-modify-write factor.
findings.nextInvestigation: Validate cache-hit fraction and write policy on the real system before relying on the estimate.
findings.confidenceRationale: Arithmetic on complete declared inputs within the explicitly bounded model; not a physical-array simulation.
assumptions: RAID 5 classic read-modify-write: each logical write costs 2 backend reads + 2 backend writes.
Write-back cache with no coalescing; sustained writes are not treated as zero.
Full-stripe writes, erasure coding, compression/dedup, metadata IO, flash write amplification, replication overhead, and rebuild load are outside this calculation.
